title: E155 Portfolio
text: Enzo Katzen is a Mathematical and Computational Biology joint major at Harvey Mudd College. Prior to studying at Harvey Mudd, he went to Brooklyn Technical High School in New York City. He is primarily interested in the field of biology, with a particular focus on developmental biology and the burgeoning field of biocomputing. He also has a strong interest in low-level programming and computer engineering, which he has explored through various projects and coursework.
